description: Authoritative English grammar syllabus mapped to CEFR levels A1-C1. Each module is one coherent teachable grammar point with honest prerequisites and demographic targeting for primary (children), middle (teens), and adult learners.

A1.label: Beginner
A1.description: Basic sentence construction, common verbs in simple forms, everyday topics.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Alphabet and Basic Word Order (SVO)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Subject-Verb-Object order as the default frame for all English sentences.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Nouns and Simple Plurals
grammar_modules.summary_note: Countable nouns, regular -s/-es plurals, common irregular plurals.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Subject Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
grammar_modules.summary_note: First pronouns before verb forms; foundation for he/she/it agreement.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
prerequisite_topics: Subject Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Distinguishing subject vs object pronoun roles in the sentence.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Possessive Adjectives and Possessive 's
prerequisite_topics: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: my/your/his/her/its/our/their + possessive apostrophe-s for ownership.

grammar_modules.topic_name: The Verb 'to be' (am, is, are)
prerequisite_topics: Subject Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
grammar_modules.summary_note: The single most-used English verb: affirmative, negative, and question forms.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Articles: a/an and the
grammar_modules.summary_note: a/an for first mention and indefinite, the for known/specific references.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Demonstratives: this, that, these, those
grammar_modules.summary_note: Proximity-based deixis, singular vs plural, near vs far.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Simple (affirmative)
prerequisite_topics: Subject Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Habits, routines, facts; third-person -s and -es spelling.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Simple: negatives with don't/doesn't
grammar_modules.summary_note: Auxiliary do/does in negation; the -s moves to the auxiliary.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Simple: questions with do/does
grammar_modules.summary_note: Yes/no questions and inversion via do/does.

grammar_modules.topic_name: The Verb 'to have' (have/has) and Have Got
grammar_modules.summary_note: Possession; have got as an informal British variant.

grammar_modules.topic_name: There is / There are
grammar_modules.summary_note: Existential constructions for describing places and objects.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Basic Adjectives and Word Order
grammar_modules.summary_note: Adjectives before nouns and after to be; no plural adjectives.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adverbs of Frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Positioning before main verbs and after to be.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Imperatives (commands and instructions)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Base-form commands, polite requests with please, negative don't.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Wh- question formation on top of yes/no question inversion.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Basic spatial relations for describing locations.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Prepositions of Time (in, on, at)
prerequisite_topics: Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: at + specific times, on + days/dates, in + months/years.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Continuous (am/is/are + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Actions in progress now; -ing spelling rules.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Simple vs Present Continuous
grammar_modules.summary_note: Habitual vs temporary/ongoing; stative verb exceptions previewed.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: Modal + bare infinitive, no -s, fixed word order before Can module.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Can / Can't for Ability and Permission
prerequisite_topics: Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: The first modal: ability, simple permission, no to after modal.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Countable and Uncountable Nouns (some/any)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Count vs mass nouns; some in positive, any in negatives/questions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: This/That/These/Those as Pronouns
grammar_modules.summary_note: Using demonstratives without a following noun, e.g. 'These are mine.'

grammar_modules.topic_name: Basic Connectors: and, but, or, so, because
grammar_modules.summary_note: Joining words and simple clauses to make longer utterances.

grammar_modules.topic_name: There is/are: questions and negatives
grammar_modules.summary_note: Is there any...? / Are there any...? / There isn't/aren't.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Like + -ing for Likes and Dislikes
grammar_modules.summary_note: First -ing form: like/love/hate/enjoy + gerund.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Possessive Pronouns (mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Standalone possessive pronouns replacing a noun phrase.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Basic Prepositions of Movement (to, from, into, out of)
prerequisite_topics: Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Direction with movement verbs like go, come, walk.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adverbs of Manner (slowly, quickly, well)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Adjective+ly forms and the irregular good/well.

grammar_modules.topic_name: The Zero Article (no article)
grammar_modules.summary_note: When no article is used: general plurals, languages, meals, school/home.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Wh- Questions with Question Words + to be
prerequisite_topics: Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Wh- questions that don't use do/does because the main verb is to be.

A2.label: Elementary
A2.description: Simple past and future, comparison, quantifiers, basic relative and modal expansion.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Simple of 'to be' (was/were)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Foundation for all past-time reference, before main-verb past.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Simple: regular verbs (-ed)
grammar_modules.summary_note: -ed endings and spelling rules; finished past actions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Simple: irregular verbs
grammar_modules.summary_note: The most frequent irregular verb list; rote memorization strategies.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Simple: negatives and questions (did)
grammar_modules.summary_note: did + base form; did not/didn't; auxiliary carries the past.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adverbs of Time Expressions (yesterday, last week, ago)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Time markers that pair with past simple.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Comparatives (-er / more)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Comparing two things; than; long vs short adjective patterns.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Superlatives (-est / most)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Comparing three or more; the + superlative + in/of.

grammar_modules.topic_name: as...as for Equality and not as...as
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expressing equal and unequal comparison.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Going to for Future Intentions and Predictions
grammar_modules.summary_note: The first future form: planned/intended future.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Will for Predictions and Offers
prerequisite_topics: Going to for Future Intentions and Predictions
Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: Spontaneous decisions, offers, promises, general predictions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Going to vs Will
prerequisite_topics: Going to for Future Intentions and Predictions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Planned intention vs spontaneous/spontaneous prediction nuance.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Continuous for Future Arrangements
prerequisite_topics: Going to for Future Intentions and Predictions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Fixed future arrangements with a time reference.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Basic Quantifiers: much, many, a lot of
grammar_modules.summary_note: Count vs uncount quantity; a lot of for both.

grammar_modules.topic_name: How much / How many and Quantifier Questions
prerequisite_topics: Basic Quantifiers: much, many, a lot of
Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Asking about quantity; responses with quantifiers.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Be going to vs Will for Predictions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Evidence-based vs opinion-based predictions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reflexive Pronouns (myself, yourself, himself...)
prerequisite_topics: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Reflexive vs reciprocal meaning; by + reflexive for alone.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Continuous (was/were + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Background action in progress at a past moment.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
grammar_modules.summary_note: Interrupted action: when + simple past in a past-continuous sentence.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Could / Couldn't for Past Ability
prerequisite_topics: Can / Can't for Ability and Permission
grammar_modules.summary_note: Past ability; could as the past of can.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Must / Mustn't: Obligation and Prohibition
prerequisite_topics: Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: Strong obligation (rules) and prohibition; mustn't vs don't have to.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Should / Shouldn't for Advice
grammar_modules.summary_note: Advice and recommendation; softer than must.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Have to / Don't have to (external obligation)
grammar_modules.summary_note: External rules vs must; distinction from mustn't (no obligation).

grammar_modules.topic_name: First Conditional (if + present simple, will)
prerequisite_topics: Basic Connectors: and, but, or, so, because
grammar_modules.summary_note: Real/possible future conditions; comma rules for if-clauses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Zero Conditional (if + present simple, present simple)
grammar_modules.summary_note: General truths and facts; when/if interchangeability.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Object Pronouns after Prepositions
prerequisite_topics: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Pronoun case after prepositions (with me, to her...).

grammar_modules.topic_name: Conjunctions: because, so, although, but (revisited)
prerequisite_topics: Basic Connectors: and, but, or, so, because
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expanding clause linking with reason, result, concession.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Relative Pronouns Who and Which (basic defining)
prerequisite_topics: Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Who for people, which for things in simple defining clauses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Possession Review: possessive s with plurals and irregulars
grammar_modules.summary_note: Marking possession on plural and irregular plural nouns.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adverbs of Degree (very, really, too, a bit)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Modifying adjectives and other adverbs.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expanding verbs that require a gerund after them.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Verb + to-infinitive: want, need, plan, hope, decide
prerequisite_topics: Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
Going to for Future Intentions and Predictions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Verbs that require to + base form.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Gerunds vs Infinitives: like/hate + -ing vs want + to
prerequisite_topics: Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
Verb + to-infinitive: want, need, plan, hope, decide
grammar_modules.summary_note: The first clear -ing vs to distinction after specific verbs.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Infinitive of Purpose (to + verb for reason)
prerequisite_topics: Verb + to-infinitive: want, need, plan, hope, decide
grammar_modules.summary_note: 'I went to the shop to buy milk.' Why/for what purpose.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Yes/No Questions and Short Answers
grammar_modules.summary_note: Auxiliary-subject inversion and natural short responses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Going to / Will questions and Short Answers
grammar_modules.summary_note: Future question formation and auxiliary-based short answers.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Prepositions of Time and Place Review and Consolidation
prerequisite_topics: Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Consolidating the common in/on/at patterns across contexts.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Too + adjective / adjective + enough
prerequisite_topics: Adverbs of Degree (very, really, too, a bit)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expressing excess and sufficiency; word order with enough.

B1.label: Intermediate
B1.description: Present perfect, future continuous/perfect, modals of deduction, all conditionals, passive, reported speech introduction.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Perfect: experience (have/has + past participle)
prerequisite_topics: The Verb 'to have' (have/has) and Have Got
grammar_modules.summary_note: Life experience without a finished time; contrast with simple past.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Perfect: already, yet, just, ever, never
grammar_modules.summary_note: Time adverbs that signal the present perfect.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
grammar_modules.summary_note: The crucial distinction: relevant-to-now vs finished-time.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Perfect for Unfinished Past (for, since)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Actions/situations that started in the past and continue now.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Present Perfect Continuous (have/has been + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Emphasis on duration/recent activity vs present perfect result focus.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Used to for Past Habits and States
grammar_modules.summary_note: Past habits no longer true; contrast with past simple.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Tag Questions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Confirming information; auxiliary + pronoun reversal rules.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
prerequisite_topics: Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: Making guesses about present situations; certainty scale.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Deduction: can't for impossible guess
prerequisite_topics: Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
grammar_modules.summary_note: can't = logical impossibility, contrasting with must.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Permission: May I...? / Can I...?
prerequisite_topics: Can / Can't for Ability and Permission
grammar_modules.summary_note: Polite permission requests in everyday and classroom contexts.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modals of Permission: may, might, can (polite)
prerequisite_topics: Can / Can't for Ability and Permission
grammar_modules.summary_note: Asking for and granting permission across formality levels.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Requests and Offers: will, would, shall, can, could
grammar_modules.summary_note: Polite requests (could you...?), suggestions (shall we...?), offers.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Second Conditional (if + past simple, would)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Unreal/hypothetical present or future; were for all persons.

grammar_modules.topic_name: First vs Second Conditional: real vs unreal
grammar_modules.summary_note: Choosing between real and hypothetical conditions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Perfect (had + past participle)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Past-before-past; sequencing two past events.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Third Conditional (if + past perfect, would have)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Unreal past; regrets and counterfactuals about finished events.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Past Perfect Continuous (had been + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Background duration leading up to a past event.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive Voice: Present Simple and Past Simple
grammar_modules.summary_note: Who/what receives the action; agent with by; first passive forms.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive Voice: Present Perfect and Future (will)
prerequisite_topics: Passive Voice: Present Simple and Past Simple
grammar_modules.summary_note: Passive with have been + pp and will be + pp.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive Voice with Modals (must be, can be, should be)
prerequisite_topics: Passive Voice: Present Simple and Past Simple
Modal verbs: Introduction to Modal Structure
grammar_modules.summary_note: General rules and possibility expressed passively.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reported Speech: statements (say/tell + backshift)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Reporting reported content; say vs tell; one-step tense backshift.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reported Speech: time and place changes
grammar_modules.summary_note: here→there, today→that day, now→then shifts.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Defining Relative Clauses (who, which, that, where)
prerequisite_topics: Relative Pronouns Who and Which (basic defining)
Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Essential information; that as an alternative; no commas.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Relative Clauses: subject vs object pronouns
prerequisite_topics: Defining Relative Clauses (who, which, that, where)
grammar_modules.summary_note: When the relative pronoun is subject vs object; who/whom.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Gerunds as Subjects and Objects
prerequisite_topics: Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
grammar_modules.summary_note: Swimming is fun / I enjoy swimming; -ing naming activities.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Infinitive after Adjectives (happy to, easy to, important to)
prerequisite_topics: Verb + to-infinitive: want, need, plan, hope, decide
grammar_modules.summary_note: It's + adjective + to-infinitive for opinion/evaluation.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Gerunds after Prepositions
prerequisite_topics: Prepositions of Time and Place Review and Consolidation
grammar_modules.summary_note: good at cooking, interested in reading.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Perfects: should have, could have, must have
prerequisite_topics: Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Regret (should have), missed opportunity (could have), past deduction (must have).

grammar_modules.topic_name: Future Continuous (will be + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Actions in progress at a future point; future arrangements.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Future Perfect (will have + past participle)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Completed by a future deadline: 'will have finished by 5pm.'

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adjectives + Prepositions (interested in, good at, afraid of)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Common adjective+preposition collocations with gerund complements.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Phrasal Verbs: introduction (separability)
prerequisite_topics: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Verb + particle combinations; pronoun placement in separable phrasals.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Questions: Embedded Questions (Do you know where...?)
prerequisite_topics: Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Polite indirect questions with statement word order.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Quantifiers: few, a few, little, a little
prerequisite_topics: Basic Quantifiers: much, many, a lot of
grammar_modules.summary_note: Positive vs negative nuance: a few vs few, a little vs little.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Both, either, neither, all, each, every
prerequisite_topics: Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Distributive and pair quantifiers; agreement rules.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Both, Either, Neither: choices
prerequisite_topics: Basic Quantifiers: much, many, a lot of
grammar_modules.summary_note: Two-item choices: both...and, either...or, neither...nor.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Adjective Order
grammar_modules.summary_note: Opinion-size-age-shape-color-origin-material-purpose order.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Linking Words: however, although, even though, despite
grammar_modules.summary_note: Contrast and concession across and within sentences.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Clauses of Result: so / such that
prerequisite_topics: Adverbs of Degree (very, really, too, a bit)
grammar_modules.summary_note: so + adjective/adverb, such + noun, that-clause of result.

B2.label: Upper-Intermediate
B2.description: Full passive across tenses, causative, reported speech expansion, all modal perfects, non-defining/reduced relatives, complex -ing patterns.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive Voice: Past Continuous and Present Perfect Continuous
prerequisite_topics: Passive Voice: Present Simple and Past Simple
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expanding passive across progressive and perfect-progressive forms.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive Voice: Future Perfect
prerequisite_topics: Passive Voice: Present Perfect and Future (will)
grammar_modules.summary_note: will have been + past participle for future completion passive.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Causative have/get (have something done)
prerequisite_topics: Passive Voice: Present Simple and Past Simple
grammar_modules.summary_note: Arranging for someone else to do something for you.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Causative get + infinitive and have + object + verb patterns
grammar_modules.summary_note: get someone to do, have someone do; causation vs arrangement.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reported Speech: questions
prerequisite_topics: Question Words (what, where, when, who, why, how)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Reporting yes/no and wh- questions; no inversion, no question mark.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reported Speech: commands and requests
grammar_modules.summary_note: tell/ask someone to do something; negative orders.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reporting Verbs (suggest, recommend, admit, deny, promise)
prerequisite_topics: Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
grammar_modules.summary_note: Reporting verbs + that-clause, + to-infinitive, or + gerund.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Mixed Conditionals (intro: past/future and 2nd/3rd mixing)
prerequisite_topics: Third Conditional (if + past perfect, would have)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Combining unreal past condition with unreal present result.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Mixed Conditionals: third→second and second→third
grammar_modules.summary_note: The two canonical mixed types in detail with usage contexts.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Wish + past simple (present wishes)
grammar_modules.summary_note: I wish I had...; were for hypothetical situations.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Wish + past perfect (regrets)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Regret about past actions: I wish I had gone.

grammar_modules.topic_name: If only + would (complaints about present)
prerequisite_topics: Modals of Permission: may, might, can (polite)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Expressing irritation about a current habit/situation.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Perfects: might have, may have, could have (deduction)
prerequisite_topics: Modal Perfects: should have, could have, must have
Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Past deduction with epistemic modality; certainty spectrum.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Perfects: needn't have / didn't need to
prerequisite_topics: Modal Perfects: should have, could have, must have
grammar_modules.summary_note: Unnecessary past action done vs not done; contrast.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal Perfects: would have (unreal conditions) review
prerequisite_topics: Third Conditional (if + past perfect, would have)
Modal Perfects: should have, could have, must have
grammar_modules.summary_note: would have in counterfactual contexts outside if-clauses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Non-defining relative clauses
prerequisite_topics: Defining Relative Clauses (who, which, that, where)
Relative Clauses: subject vs object pronouns
grammar_modules.summary_note: Extra, non-essential info with commas; no that.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Defining vs Non-defining relative clauses
prerequisite_topics: Defining Relative Clauses (who, which, that, where)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Punctuation and meaning contrast; omission rules.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Reduced relative clauses (participle -ing / -ed)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Dropping the relative pronoun + be in active/passive clauses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Relative clauses with prepositions
prerequisite_topics: Relative Clauses: subject vs object pronouns
Prepositions of Place (in, on, under, next to, behind, between)
grammar_modules.summary_note: the person who I talked to / to whom I talked; formal vs informal.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Gerunds and Infinitives: complex patterns (remember, stop, try, regret)
prerequisite_topics: Gerunds vs Infinitives: like/hate + -ing vs want + to
Verb + -ing: enjoy, love, hate, finish, mind
grammar_modules.summary_note: Verbs whose meaning changes between gerund and infinitive.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Gerund/Infinitive: perfect and passive forms (having done, to be told)
prerequisite_topics: Gerunds and Infinitives: complex patterns (remember, stop, try, regret)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Advanced -ing/to forms for perfect and passive meaning.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Verb + object + infinitive (ask/tell/want someone to do)
prerequisite_topics: Verb + to-infinitive: want, need, plan, hope, decide
Object Pronouns (me, you, him, her, it, us, them)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Two-object patterns: ask/tell/allow/want + object + to-infinitive.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Let / Make + object + base form (causative verbs)
prerequisite_topics: Verb + object + infinitive (ask/tell/want someone to do)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Bare infinitive complements; passive forms (was made to do).

grammar_modules.topic_name: used to vs be/get used to
prerequisite_topics: Used to for Past Habits and States
grammar_modules.summary_note: Past habit (used to + base) vs accustomed to (+ -ing).

grammar_modules.topic_name: Articles: advanced uses (the with names, zero article refinement)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Geographical names, institutions, meals, media; fine distinctions.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Comparatives: (not) as...as and the...the...
prerequisite_topics: as...as for Equality and not as...as
grammar_modules.summary_note: Proportional and comparative-parallel structures.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Conditionals: alternatives to if (unless, in case, provided that)
prerequisite_topics: Third Conditional (if + past perfect, would have)
grammar_modules.summary_note: unless = if...not; formal conditional markers.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Inversion after negative adverbials (never, rarely, hardly)
prerequisite_topics: Clauses of Result: so / such that
Adverbs of Frequency (always, usually, sometimes, never)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Emphatic subject-auxiliary inversion in formal/academic English.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Embedded questions and noun clauses (advanced)
prerequisite_topics: Questions: Embedded Questions (Do you know where...?)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Noun clauses as subjects/objects; whether/if; word order.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modal verbs: be able to, had to (suppletive forms)
prerequisite_topics: Have to / Don't have to (external obligation)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Modal-gap filling: was/were able to, had to for all tenses.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Future Perfect Continuous (will have been + -ing)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Duration continuing up to a future point.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Discourse: linkers of addition and contrast (furthermore, whereas, nevertheless)
prerequisite_topics: Linking Words: however, although, even though, despite
grammar_modules.summary_note: Formal linking for essays and academic writing.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Prepositional verbs vs phrasal verbs (advanced)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Transitive/intransitive distinctions; particle vs preposition placement.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Conditional without if: inversion (Had I known, Were I you)
prerequisite_topics: Inversion after negative adverbials (never, rarely, hardly)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Formal conditional inversion; had/should/were fronting.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Emphatic do/did (I do agree, do sit down)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Emphasis and insistence in affirmative and imperative contexts.

C1.label: Advanced
C1.description: Refined discourse control, advanced passive/reporting, complex -ing forms and fronting, nuanced modality.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Advanced Passive constructions (It is said that..., He is believed to...)
prerequisite_topics: Reporting Verbs (suggest, recommend, admit, deny, promise)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Impersonal passive and double-agent passive for reporting/opinion.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Passive with get and passive infinitive (-ing)
prerequisite_topics: Advanced Passive constructions (It is said that..., He is believed to...)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Get-passives (get broken), being + past participle.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Hedging and modality of certainty/uncertainty
prerequisite_topics: Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
Modal Perfects: might have, may have, could have (deduction)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Fine-grained degree of certainty: must/could/might/may + adverbs (perhaps, presumably).

grammar_modules.topic_name: Mixed and extended conditional structures (advanced)
prerequisite_topics: Conditional without if: inversion (Had I known, Were I you)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Interlocking conditionals, implied conditions, counterfactual nuance.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Cleft constructions (It was X that..., What I want is...)
prerequisite_topics: Emphatic do/did (I do agree, do sit down)
Inversion after negative adverbials (never, rarely, hardly)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Focusing and emphasis through it-clefts and wh-clefts.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Fronting and inversion for emphasis (advanced)
prerequisite_topics: Inversion after negative adverbials (never, rarely, hardly)
Cleft constructions (It was X that..., What I want is...)
grammar_modules.summary_note: So + adjective at sentence start, resource/style inversion.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Nominalization and noun phrases in academic writing
prerequisite_topics: Discourse: linkers of addition and contrast (furthermore, whereas, nevertheless)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Turning verbs into nouns for dense, formal register.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Complex noun phrases with multiple modifiers
prerequisite_topics: Nominalization and noun phrases in academic writing
grammar_modules.summary_note: Stacking determiners, adjectives, participles, and relative/postmodifiers.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Advanced reporting: reporting verbs + infinitive/gerund and patterns
prerequisite_topics: Reporting Verbs (suggest, recommend, admit, deny, promise)
Verb + object + infinitive (ask/tell/want someone to do)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Mastery of verb complementation in reported discourse.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Comment clauses and stance adverbials (it seems, as far as I know)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Speaker stance markers that frame the whole utterance.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Participle clauses (Having finished, she left; Written in 1900...)
prerequisite_topics: Gerund/Infinitive: perfect and passive forms (having done, to be told)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Subordinating with present and past participles without an overt subject.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Absolute constructions and appositives
prerequisite_topics: Participle clauses (Having finished, she left; Written in 1900...)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Standalone noun+participle clauses; noun-phrase apposition.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Subjunctive and formal structures (It is essential that he be...)
prerequisite_topics: Complex noun phrases with multiple modifiers
grammar_modules.summary_note: Present subjunctive after require/essential/suggest in formal register.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Ellipsis and substitution (advanced)
prerequisite_topics: Discourse: linkers of addition and contrast (furthermore, whereas, nevertheless)
Comment clauses and stance adverbials (it seems, as far as I know)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Omission for conciseness; do/so/one as substitutes.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Advanced cohesive devices (reference chains, hedged connectors)
prerequisite_topics: Discourse: linkers of addition and contrast (furthermore, whereas, nevertheless)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Cohesion through reference, substitution, ellipsis, and conjunction.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Style and register: formal vs informal grammar choices
prerequisite_topics: Subjunctive and formal structures (It is essential that he be...)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Contractions, relative pronoun choice, passive vs active for tone.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Nuanced tense selection (narrative, future-in-past)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Storytelling tense patterns; would for future-in-the-past.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Advanced article use in complex noun phrases
prerequisite_topics: Articles: advanced uses (the with names, zero article refinement)
Complex noun phrases with multiple modifiers
grammar_modules.summary_note: Article choice with of-phrases, gerund modifiers, and abstract nouns.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Advanced conditional: implied and elliptical conditions
grammar_modules.summary_note: Conditions implied by context; 'What if...?', 'If only...'.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Focused degree and extent structures (so...that, such...that, too...to)
prerequisite_topics: Clauses of Result: so / such that
grammar_modules.summary_note: Strong consequence and sufficiency patterns for emphasis.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Modality: will, would, must for assumptions and predictions (advanced)
prerequisite_topics: Modal Deduction: must, might, may, could (present)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Epistemic uses beyond simple deduction: presumably, expected behavior.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Grammar of academic citation and reference
prerequisite_topics: Advanced reporting: reporting verbs + infinitive/gerund and patterns
grammar_modules.summary_note: Attribution, hedging, and tense choices typical of academic prose.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Complete tense-aspect system review (challenging mixed practice)
prerequisite_topics: Advanced Passive constructions (It is said that..., He is believed to...)
grammar_modules.summary_note: Integrative review of the full tense-aspect-passive-modality matrix.

grammar_modules.topic_name: Consolidation: integrated grammar discourse project
prerequisite_topics: Complete tense-aspect system review (challenging mixed practice)
Style and register: formal vs informal grammar choices
grammar_modules.summary_note: Applying all learned grammar to extended academic/formal writing.
